title: The specified unbounded affine coordinate-tower compact-support comparison
statement: Let $u$ be a universe, $A$ a finite commutative ring of universe $u+1$, and $S$ a Noetherian scheme of universe $u$. Use the ordered coordinate tower $X_0=S$, $X_{r+1}=\mathbf A^1_{X_r}$ and its projections $p_r:X_r\to S$, with the standard affine-line compactifications $c_r$ [def-amb-affine-trace-tower]. Write $F_r:D(X_{r,\mathrm{et}},A)\to D(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ for the literal ordered left functor of [def-amb-affine-trace-construction], so $F_0=1$ and $F_{r+1}=F_r\circ F_{\mathrm{line},r}$. Write $Rf_!$ for the ordinary unbounded compact-support functor of [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. Define the specified natural isomorphism $C_r:F_r\xrightarrow\sim Rp_{r!}$ by recursion. At zero it is the inverse of the identity comparison $R(1_S)_!\xrightarrow\sim1$. At $r+1$, first compare the chosen standard line compactification functor $F_{\mathrm{line},r}$ with $Ru_{r!}$ by the compactification comparison, whiskered by $F_r$; next apply $C_r$ after $Ru_{r!}$; finally apply the proper/open unbounded compositor $Rp_{r!}Ru_{r!}\xrightarrow\sim R(p_ru_r)_!$. All identity, compactification and composition comparisons are precisely those of [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. This defines $C_r$ on all unbounded inputs, including $r=0$, with no invertibility assertion about an affine trace and no use of uniqueness of right adjoints.

def affineDualizingTowerComparison (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] : (r : ℕ) →
    affineTraceLeft A S r ≅
      rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (affineTraceProjection S r)
